final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.ordertypedist AS otd, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT otd, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY otd) SELECT s1.translink, s1.otd, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.otd = s2.otd ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
